Sam: Heads up - after recent TS SDK header rename some console route heatmaps are showing gaps for a handful of tenants.
Priya: Which header? we changed route-priority -> x-rd-route in the compact header change.
Ken: Confirmed. SDK now emits x-rd-route; our console ingestion still keys on legacy 'route-tag'. Proxy strips unknown headers so metrics-ingest sees nothing.
Ivy: Quick mitigation: add a lightweight remap in metrics-ingest: if x-rd-route present set tag route_tag = x-rd-route. Put behind FF for 24h.
Sam: Also add SDK opt-in env var RD_LEGACY_ROUTE=1 for canary customers to emit legacy header until mapping fully rolled.
Priya: Add telemetry ping from SDK when env var enabled: event=route_compat, sdk=ts, mode=legacy to track uptake.
Ken: Note: aggregator dedupe uses the tag key; ensure we don't double-count when both headers present. Prefer new header if both exist.
CI-bot: staging deploy kicked off by @Ivy  build 1420 - logs: https://ci.redwood/build/1420
Ivy: Staging looks good, enabling FF for 10% now. Will monitor dashboards for 2hrs. :eyes:
